title: The Invisible School
text: Imagine a tiny baby learning to walk, talk, and smile. Long before this child ever packs a school bag, buys a uniform, or steps into a classroom, they have already learned so much! But who is their teacher? Where is this 'invisible school' located?

title: Think About It
text: Think about the very first word you ever spoke. Was it 'Maa', 'Papa', or something else? Were you sitting at a wooden desk looking at a teacher when you learned it? How did you learn to eat with your own hands?

content.title: The Roots of Learning
content.description: Imagine a beautiful, strong tree. The school is like the branches and leaves, reaching out into the world. But the deep, invisible roots that give the tree its strength are grown at home.

title: Our First School
text: The answer to our mystery is our **Family**. Our family is our very first school! Here, there are no bells or blackboards. Instead, our parents, grandparents, and siblings teach us essential life skills, values, and how to love and care for others.

content.definition: A group of people connected by blood or love who live together, support each other, and teach us our first habits.
A behavior that we repeat regularly without thinking, like brushing our teeth or saying 'Please' and 'Thank you'.

content.title: Did you know?
content.text: Many people think that 'education' only happens in a school building with textbooks. In reality, the most important education—how to be a good human being—starts at home!

content.question: Which of the following is considered a child's 'First School'?

title: Time to Reflect
text: Close your eyes and think about your own family. Who taught you how to tie your shoelaces? Who taught you how to respect your elders? Every family member is a special teacher in your life.

content.title: A Note from Your Teacher
content.text: Whenever you notice a good habit in yourself, like sharing your toys, look closely at your family members. You will often see that you learned this beautiful habit by watching them!

title: Connecting the Dots
text: In our family, we learn to share our things, care for each other, and work as a team. When we finally go to a formal school, we use these same skills to make wonderful friends and help our classmates. The family is the foundation for everything we do later in life!

content.title: The Family Tree Challenge
content.instructions: Take a colorful sheet of paper and draw a beautiful family tree. Under each family member's picture, write down one special good habit or skill that you have learned from them. Show it to them and say 'Thank you, my first teacher!'
